import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_a_trig_unit (x : ℝ) : (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 = 1 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_a_trig_unit (x : ℝ) : (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 = 1
:= by
  have h1 : (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 = Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x := by
    simp
  have h2 : Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x = Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x + (Real.sin x * Real.cos x - Real.sin x * Real.cos x) := by
    simp
  have h3 : Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x + (Real.sin x * Real.cos x - Real.sin x * Real.cos x) = Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * (Real.cos x + Real.sin x) - Real.sin x * Real.cos x := by
    simp
  have h4 : Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * (Real.cos x + Real.sin x) - Real.sin x * Real.cos x = Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x + Real.cos x * Real.sin x - Real.sin x * Real.cos x := by
    simp
  have h5 : Real.sin x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x * Real.cos x + Real.cos x * Real.sin x - Real.sin x * Real.cos x = Real.cos x * Real.cos x + (Real.sin x * Real.sin x - Real.sin x * Real.sin x) := by
    simp
  have h6 : Real.cos x * Real.cos x + (Real.sin x * Real.sin x - Real.sin x * Real.sin x) = 1 - (Real.sin x) ^ 2 - (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 := by
    simp
  have h7 : 1 - (Real.sin x) ^ 2 - (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 = 1 - (Real.sin x) ^ 2 + (Real.cos x) ^ 2 := by
    simp
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_a_trig_unit = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_a_trig_unit := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.study_a_trig_unit
